settings.headline: Numbing cream delivery, in plain terms.
settings.subhead: Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Free next-day delivery on orders over £80. Order before 1pm on a working day and your parcel is dispatched the same day. Everything ships from the United Kingdom via Royal Mail, in plain, unbranded packaging.
settings.image_alt: Senseless parcel packed for UK delivery

settings.headline: Yes, next-day delivery is available.
settings.body:
Next-day delivery is one of the two options at checkout, and it is free on UK orders over £80. Below that the rate is shown at checkout before you pay. Standard delivery is free on UK orders over £40.

The cut-off is the part that decides whether your order moves today. Order before 1pm on a working day and it is dispatched the same day. Order after 1pm, or at a weekend or on a bank holiday, and it is dispatched the next working day. Delivery estimates begin from dispatch, not from when you place the order.

settings.headline: Standard or next-day.
settings.caption: UK delivery options, thresholds and dispatch cut-off
settings.note: Orders placed after 1pm, at a weekend or on a bank holiday are dispatched the next working day. Delivery estimates begin from dispatch. We ship to the UK only at present.

settings.label: Carrier
settings.value: All orders ship from the United Kingdom via Royal Mail.

settings.label: Tracking
settings.value: A confirmation email with a tracking link is sent on dispatch. Track directly at royalmail.com/track-your-item.

settings.label: Packaging
settings.value: Every order is dispatched in plain, unbranded packaging. Parcels are designed to fit through a standard letterbox wherever possible.

settings.label: Where we ship
settings.value: The United Kingdom only at present.

settings.label: If something goes wrong
settings.value: Damaged, missing or late beyond the expected window — email cs@senseless.uk with your order number, within 14 days of the expected delivery date.

settings.heading: Leave yourself a working day in hand.
settings.body: The two things that decide when a parcel arrives are the 1pm cut-off and the working-day calendar, and a bank holiday moves both. If your appointment is close, next-day delivery ordered before 1pm on a working day is the quickest route we offer — and if it is not close, standard delivery over £40 costs nothing and gives you room if a parcel is delayed.

settings.question: Do you offer next-day delivery on numbing cream?
settings.answer: Yes. Next-day delivery is available at checkout on every product in the range, and it is free on UK orders over £80. Order before 1pm on a working day and your parcel is dispatched the same day.

settings.question: How much does delivery cost?
settings.answer: Standard UK delivery is free on orders over £40. Next-day delivery is free on orders over £80. Below those thresholds the rate for each option is shown at checkout before you pay.

settings.question: What is the cut-off for same-day dispatch?
settings.answer: 1pm on a working day. Orders placed after 1pm, at a weekend, or on a bank holiday are dispatched the next working day. Delivery estimates begin from dispatch.

settings.question: Will it arrive before my appointment?
settings.answer: That depends on when you order rather than on anything about the product. Next-day delivery placed before 1pm on a working day is the quickest route available; a weekend or a bank holiday pushes dispatch to the next working day. If the appointment is close, order early in the day and choose next-day.

settings.question: Is the packaging discreet?
settings.answer: Yes. Every order is dispatched in plain, unbranded packaging, and parcels are designed to fit through a standard letterbox wherever possible.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: A confirmation email with a Royal Mail tracking link is sent as soon as your order is dispatched. You can also track directly at royalmail.com/track-your-item. If nothing arrives within 24 hours, check your spam folder, then email cs@senseless.uk.

settings.question: Do you deliver outside the UK?
settings.answer: Not at present. We ship to the United Kingdom only.

settings.question: Can I change my delivery address after ordering?
settings.answer: If the order has not been dispatched yet, email cs@senseless.uk and we will change it. Once it has been dispatched the address cannot be changed.

settings.question: My order hasn't arrived. What now?
settings.answer: Check the tracking link first — it is the fastest answer. If the expected window has passed with no update, email cs@senseless.uk with your order number. Please report delivery problems within 14 days of the expected delivery date.
